clips.name: weave
clips.alt: Weave on black at its default settings: grey wool threads are pulled in one by one, first the upright warps from the left, then the wefts row by row, until a woven net about two thirds of the frame wide hangs in a light wind
clips.caption: Weave at its default settings, on black: the net is finished after four seconds.

clips.name: weave-presets
clips.alt: Four Weave presets on black in a grid, in sync: Red Thread top left, a red net weaving itself in slowly; Linen Grid top right, an even white grid; Nest bottom left, a round patch of brown, fuzzy wool; Qualle bottom right, a cream knitted jellyfish whose bell pulses and whose long ribbons curl
clips.caption: The four presets on black, in sync.

clips.name: weave-weave-speed
clips.alt: The grey net weaving itself in fast at Weave Speed 2.5: the warps and wefts are in place after about a second and a half, then the sheet hangs and sways
clips.caption: Weave Speed 2.5: the net is finished after 1.6 seconds.

clips.name: weave-reveal
clips.alt: The grey net while Reveal runs from 0 to 1 and back: a small round patch with a frayed rim grows from the middle until the whole sheet is there, then shrinks to nothing; the current value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Reveal from 0 to 1 and back.

clips.name: weave-irregularity
clips.alt: The grey net while Irregularity runs from 0 to 3 and back: the even grid turns crooked and fuzzy, with uneven spacing and thicker places, and straightens again; the current value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Irregularity from 0 to 3 and back.

clips.name: weave-wind
clips.alt: The grey net at three wind strengths, two seconds each: at Wind 0 it hangs flat, at 0.35 its edges sway gently, at 2 it bellies out towards you; the value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Wind 0, 0.35 and 2, two seconds each.

clips.name: weave-pulse-rate
clips.alt: The Qualle jellyfish at three pulse rates, two seconds each: at 0 the bell stays still and only the ribbons drift, at 0.4 it contracts slowly, at 1.2 quickly; the value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Pulse Rate 0, 0.4 and 1.2 Hz, two seconds each.

clips.name: weave-pulse-size
clips.alt: The Qualle jellyfish while Pulse Size runs from 0 to 0.6 and back: the round bell starts to contract and stretch the body with each pulse, more and more, then calms again; the value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Pulse Size from 0 to 0.6 and back.

clips.name: weave-curl-strength
clips.alt: The Qualle jellyfish while Curl Strength runs from 0 to 0.2 and back: the smooth hanging ribbons begin to swirl and loop outwards on both sides, then settle into calm loops again; the value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Curl Strength from 0 to 0.2 and back.

clips.name: flocking
clips.alt: Flocking on black at its default settings: a cloud of fine pale blue points flies as one swarm, folds, splits into two lobes and gathers again in the middle of the frame
clips.caption: Flocking at its default settings (Free Swarm), on black.
clips.note: Flocking acts on its swarm graph, not on effect params, so doc-clip cannot export it yet: the exports come from a helper that applies the flock preset and keys the named card control ("flock"), then `--reencode --keep <folder>` encodes them.

clips.name: flocking-presets
clips.alt: The five Flocking presets on black in a grid, in sync: Free Swarm, a cloud of pale points; Krill Cloud, orange krill swimming in clusters; Follow Path, a school tracing a figure eight with fine trails; Technical Network, points joined by thin blue lines; Violet Filaments, a dense violet cloud with curved filaments and small wire cubes
clips.caption: The five presets on black, in sync.
clips.note: Flocking acts on its swarm graph, not on effect params, so doc-clip cannot export it yet: the exports come from a helper that applies the flock preset and keys the named card control ("flock"), then `--reencode --keep <folder>` encodes them.

clips.name: flocking-population
clips.alt: The Free Swarm with three populations, two seconds each: 500 sparse points, the default 4000, and 20000 points that read as a dense, glowing cloud; the number is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Population 500, 4000 and 20000, two seconds each.
clips.note: Flocking acts on its swarm graph, not on effect params, so doc-clip cannot export it yet: the exports come from a helper that applies the flock preset and keys the named card control ("flock"), then `--reencode --keep <folder>` encodes them.
